title: Life Cycles of Living Things
seo_title: Primary 3 Basic Science: Life Cycles of Living Things Worksheets (NERDC)
standard_code: Primary 3 Basic Science: Living and Non-Living Things
standard_text: Plants and animals have life cycles: seeds germinate, grow, flower and make seeds; animals are born or hatch, grow, reproduce and die. Life cycles can be compared. (summary of the Basic Science curriculum, Primary 3, theme: Living and Non-Living Things)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 Basic Science worksheets (NERDC curriculum, theme: Living and Non-Living Things): plant life cycles, germination, animal life cycles, comparing life cycles and metamorphosis. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Every living thing has a life cycle.
key_sub: A seed needs water, warmth and air to germinate.
body_html:
How to think about it

A flowering plant's life cycle: seed → seedling → adult plant → flower → fruit and seeds. A seed germinates when it has water, warmth and air.

Animal life cycles: mammals are born live and grow; birds and most reptiles hatch from eggs; insects such as butterflies and amphibians such as frogs undergo metamorphosis. All living things reproduce so that the species continues.

Example

What does a seed need to germinate?

Not light

Answer: water, air and warmth

Example

Stages of a frog?

Four stages

Answer: egg → tadpole → froglet → adult

Common mistakes

  • Thinking seeds need light to germinate.
  • Thinking all young animals look like their parents.
  • Thinking plants do not have a life cycle.

items.q: Does a seed need soil to start growing (germinate)?
c: Only if it is a big seed.
Yes, a seed cannot start without soil.
No. A seed has food stored inside, so it can start growing without soil.
items.e: Seeds need water, warmth and air to germinate. They use food stored inside them until their leaves grow.

items.q: Does a seed need water to start growing (germinate)?

items.q: Does a seed need light to germinate?
c: Yes, but only in the day.
No. A seed can germinate without it.
Yes. A seed cannot germinate without it.
items.e: Seeds can germinate on wet cotton wool in the dark. They need light later, when the young plant grows.
